messages.content: Create a folder named TEST-WORFLOW, then generate a newsletter website, using html,css and js

Created the folder TEST-WORFLOW and generated a newsletter website with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files. The website includes a header, main content section with articles, and a footer. The CSS provides a clean and modern style, and the JavaScript adds interactivity to the articles.
